title: tsx futures muted ahead domestic us jobs reports 2026 09 04
text:
Sept 4 (Reuters) - Canada's main stock index closed lower on Friday as material and oil stocks declined and stronger-than-expected U.S. jobs ​data prompted investors to increase bets on an interest-rate hike ‌by the Federal Reserve this month.
